data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1110 for the year ended 31 December 2019 is a loss of GBP 0.2m (2018: profit of GBP 6.8m) of which a loss of GBP 0.4m is attributable to the 2019 year of account and a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation and quota share arrangements with ProSight Group subsidiaries
prior_year_events.impact_description: Commuted treaty business as at 31 March 2017 that originated from ProSight Group subsidiaries and agreed a 100% quota share for delegated underwriting authority business (part of novation arrangements); these actions affected the run-off of historical liabilities.

named_events.event_name: Loss portfolio transfer (LPT) from Hamilton Underwriting Limited (Syndicate 3334)
named_events.loss_description: Entered into an LPT for certain lines of discontinued business for underwriting years 2016 to 2018 inclusive; resulted in an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m and gross written premium of GBP 59.7m. No associated outwards reinsurance as the contract has been ceded net.

named_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close (RITC) of Syndicate 3330 (2017 & prior years)
named_events.loss_description: Effective 1 January 2020, Syndicate 1110 has accepted the RITC of the liabilities of run-off Syndicate 3330, 2017 and prior years; will result in a transfer to Syndicate 1110's gross and net technical provisions of approximately GBP 8.4m and GBP 6.9m respectively.

named_events.event_name: Commutation of ProSight Group treaty business
named_events.loss_description: PSMAL commuted the treaty business as at 31 March 2017 that originated from New York Marine and General Insurance Company, Southwest Marine and General Insurance Company and Gotham Insurance Company (subsidiaries of the ProSight Group).

named_events.event_name: Novation of syndicate management from Coverys at Lloyd's to Capita Managing Agency Limited
named_events.loss_description: On 25 October 2019 the management of Syndicate 1110 was novated from Coverys at Lloyd's (CaL) to Capita Managing Agency Limited (CMA).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 93.512m at 1 January 2019. The Syndicate reports a small favourable prior-year outcome: a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account, indicating a modest release of reserves. This movement is small relative to opening reserves and the Syndicate's reserve position was materially impacted in 2019 by a loss portfolio transfer (LPT) from Hamilton Underwriting Ltd which increased gross technical provisions by GBP 60.1m (primarily Professional Lines). Changes in accounting treatment for loss funds and provisions for ULAE are also noted and may affect comparability of reserve movements.
raw_causal_phrases: a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account.
A provision has been made for unallocated loss adjusted expenses(ULAE) of GBP 4,235k (2017 year of account) and GBP 542k (2019 year of account), which is included within the technical provisions.
The managing agent considers that the ULAE reserve is sufficient to allow the Syndicate to run-off the 2017 year and meet its liabilities as they fall due.

On 23 December 2019 Syndicate 1110 entered into a loss portfolio transfer (LPT) reinsurance with Syndicate 3334, managed by Hamilton Underwriting Limited (HUL), for certain lines of discontinued business for underwriting years 2016 to 2018 inclusive. The transaction resulted in an increase to Syndicate 1110's gross written premium of GBP 59.7m and an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m.
Syndicate 1110 has no associated outwards reinsurance in relation to the LPT as the contract has been ceded net, already benefiting from the HUL reinsurance programme.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note was found. Prior-year development was inferred from the year-of-account result breakdown (a profit of GBP 0.2m attributable to 2017 & prior years) which is a permitted primary source but represents an underwriting result (includes premium, investment effects and reinsurance) rather than a pure gross reserve movement. The 2019 LPT (gross +60.1m) and change in loss-funds accounting materially affect comparability of gross reserves. RITC accepted effective 1 Jan 2020 (+GBP 8.4m gross) further affects the reserve base post-balance sheet.
